validated_results.title: Associations between bladder cancer risk factors and tumor stage and grade at diagnosis.
validated_results.reason: Population-based case-control analysis of the National Bladder Cancer Study reports artificial sweetener use in relation to incident bladder cancer (by stage/grade) versus population controls, so the nutritional exposure and target cancer incidence context are both present.

extraction.comparison_type: Heavy artificial sweetener use versus lower/no use
extraction.population: Bladder cancer cases and population-based controls from the National Bladder Cancer Study

sample_size.excerpt: Using data on 1,860 bladder cancer cases and 3,934 population-based controls from the National Bladder Cancer Study, we examined associations between suspected bladder cancer risk factors and tumor stage and grade.
sample_size.location: abstract; total_n derived from reported group counts 1860 + 3934 = 5794

cases.excerpt: Using data on 1,860 bladder cancer cases and 3,934 population-based controls from the National Bladder Cancer Study, we examined associations between suspected bladder cancer risk factors and tumor stage and grade.

comparison.excerpt: Heavy artificial sweetener use was associated with higher-grade, poorly differentiated tumors.

design.excerpt: 1,860 bladder cancer cases and 3,934 population-based controls from the National Bladder Cancer Study

validated_results.title: [Influence of Lactobacillus casei on rat bladder carcinogenesis].
validated_results.journal: Nihon Hinyokika Gakkai zasshi. The japanese journal of urology
validated_results.reason: The study evaluated Lactobacillus casei only in BBN-induced rat bladder carcinogenesis, an exclusively animal experiment.

validated_results.title: Ethnic distribution of the glutathione transferase Mu 1-1 (GSTM1) null genotype in 1473 individuals and application to bladder cancer susceptibility.
validated_results.reason: The exposure is the GSTM1 null genotype (glutathione transferase deficiency), not nutritional glutathione intake or circulating glutathione.

validated_results.title: Modulation of urinary mutagenicity by genetically determined carcinogen metabolism in smokers.
validated_results.reason: The outcome is urinary mutagenicity by GSTM1/NAT2 genotype in smokers, with no incident bladder cancer results reported.

validated_results.title: Etiology of bladder cancer.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review of bladder cancer etiology rather than an original human study of tea intake.

validated_results.title: Chemoprevention by indomethacin of tumor promotion in a rat urinary bladder carcinogenesis model.
validated_results.reason: Sodium L-ascorbate and indomethacin effects were tested only in a rat urinary bladder carcinogenesis model.
